Subject: Discovery recap + MAP — next steps

Hi Elena / Jorge —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our 30-min discovery so we’re aligned and can surface a short MAP to procurement: 

- Goal: Reduce inference cost and stabilize 99th%-tile latency for your customer insights pipeline (esp. nightly batch + low-latency web queries).
- Primary constraints: Data residency for PII-derived embeddings, existing cloud spend cap, and a hard go-live target for pilot on Jan 15.
- Success metric: 40% token-cost reduction on the nightly job OR 20% end-to-end latency improvement for web queries while preserving accuracy within 1% of current model outputs.

I attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan (CoreMetrics-MAP-v1.xlsx) that outlines milestones, owners, and a short procurement checklist (SLA/CISO requests). Please take a look and suggest any changes to owners or dates.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) You to confirm the pilot scope (subset of datasets + traffic shape) by 11/17.
2) Redwood to deliver a technical runbook and a cost estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted pilot by 11/20.
3) Schedule a short kickoff (30 min) week of 11/29 once scope is locked.

If the 1/15 target is aggressive, flag it here — we can timebox the pilot instead. Also dropping a Drive link for the MAP: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d-coremetrics-map

Attachments: CoreMetrics-MAP-v1.xlsx (attachment)

Thanks,

Possible options:
- Nudge again with a short deadline and offer a no-cost pilot evaluation window (1 week) to surface value fast.
- Suggest a modest 15% pilot discount to get commitment for the Jan pilot.

Any preference? If you think discounts should be tied to contract terms, I can propose a small one tied to a 6–12 month Reserved commitment.

I’m going to send one more customer-facing nudge Friday; want to be aligned on escalation and any approvals before I do.

—Neha
